prompts: We playtested two versions of the Pixel Arena tutorial and have to pick one for the next release. The export and its notes are in {WS}/telemetry. Should we ship B instead of A? Give a recommendation a skeptical lead would accept. Record it in {WS}/result.json with ship_b, sessions_a, sessions_b, completion_rate_a, completion_rate_b and p_value.
answers:
[goal] **Ship B.** Tutorial completion rose from 38.00% with A (342/900 sessions) to 46.67% with B (420/900), a gain of 8.67 percentage points.

[action] I normalized variant labels and removed 70 resent rows by `session_id`. All repeats agreed on variant, player, and completion. I treated completion per session as the release metric and assumed the variants were assigned comparably.

[result] The two-sided pooled proportions test gave `p_value = 0.00019846895397607585`, below the 0.05 release threshold. I saved and read back all six requested fields in [result.json](./result.json).

[next] Release B. Because some players contributed multiple sessions, I also checked uncertainty by grouping sessions by player. The gain remained significant: `Player-clustered p=0.00027265; 95% gain interval 4.00 to 13.33 pp`.
